title: The woman who fooled England's doctors into believing she gave birth to rabbits
hook: A woman convinced top doctors she was giving birth to rabbits.
summary: In 1726 Mary Toft convinced respected doctors, even the king's surgeon, that she gave birth to rabbits, until a smuggled rabbit exposed the hoax.
sources: Wikipedia: Mary Toft - Godalming 1726 hoax, John Howard, Nathaniel St André, confession, Hogarth satire
Encyclopaedia Britannica and Science Museum / Royal College of Physicians accounts of the Mary Toft rabbit hoax

lines.text: A woman convinced top doctors that she was giving birth to rabbits.
lines.caps: A woman *convinced | top *doctors | giving birth to *rabbits

lines.text: Mary Toft, a poor worker from Godalming, did it in seventeen twenty-six.
A local surgeon believed her, and wrote to experts in London.
The king sent his own surgeon, who was convinced too.
Newspapers spread the story across the whole country.
But a porter was caught smuggling a rabbit to her room.
Mary confessed it was a hoax.
Artists mocked the doctors, and the royal surgeon's career was over.

post.caption:
In 1726, England's best doctors believed a woman was giving birth to rabbits.
Would you have been fooled too?
